meanings.note: Colloquial clipped form pera / pera aí from espera (esperar).
Adds immediacy after imperatives like calma aí, or means there near you.
Friendly collective address for coworkers in a room or message.
Subject form referring to the speaker. Explicit eu introduces his department in the explanation.
A negative answer or a negation in a sentence. A final repeated não can reinforce a conversational refusal in Brazil.
Takes the preposition em (confiar em).

examples.text: Eu não confio em mapeamento eletrônico.
examples.trans: I do not trust electronic mapping.

examples.text: Você pode confiar na nossa equipe.

meanings.note: Usually contracts with definite articles to no, na, nos, nas.
Technical diagram or mapping of a system.

meanings.note: Followed by an infinitive for your own wish (quero saber) or que + subjunctive for someone else (quero que você entre).

examples.text: Eu só quero saber o motivo.
examples.trans: I just want to know the reason.

meanings.note: Printed on paper rather than digital.
Used for identifying a type of meeting or the department a person belongs to. The present forms sou and é are irregular.
All-purpose connector, relative link, question opener, and comparative word after mais or melhor.

examples.text: Eu acho que ele já foi.
examples.trans: I think that he already left.

meanings.note: Verbs in -ear take -ei- in rhizotonic present forms and -eei in 1st sg past (mapeei).

examples.text: A gente conseguiu mapear a placa.
examples.trans: We managed to map the board.

examples.text: Fui eu que mapeei o circuito.
examples.trans: I am the one who mapped the circuit.

meanings.note: Expresses possession, obligation in ter que + infinitive, and impersonal existence (tem alguns números, there are some numbers).

examples.text: Eu tenho que entrar lá dentro.

meanings.note: Highest academic graduate degree.

examples.trans: I have a doctorate in engineering.

meanings.note: Expresses sudden realization or understanding.

examples.trans: Look at the young woman over there.

meanings.note: First-person singular possessive agreeing with the thing possessed.

meanings.note: Neutral pronoun for 'everything / all of it'.
